intro_text: Delivering sustainable, year-round aid through our structured education and community development programmes.

initiatives.title: LIGHT A DREAM SCHOLARSHIP
initiatives.description: The Light-A-Dream Scholarship (LADS) is a long-standing initiative that invests in the education of selected students (Grades 7 through university) with financial need, empowering them to contribute back to their community.

initiatives.title: SCHOOL SUPPORT PROGRAMME
initiatives.description: Implemented at Santipheap Primary School to improve learning environments directly. Project Battambang funded clean water wells and sanitation facilities, alongside health education curricula.

initiatives.title: POST-SCREENING EDUCATION
initiatives.description: Delivering targeted health lessons during screenings on topics including personal hygiene, dental care, nutrition, vector-borne bites, hair lice prevention, and chronic disease management.
